about.title: What is Unseen Bangladesh?
about.body1: Unseen Bangladesh is a free guide to all 64 districts. Next to the famous beaches and hills it highlights lesser-known places, like a haor in the monsoon, an old mosque or a tea garden at dawn, with the best months, how to get there and what it costs.
about.body2: It works in Bengali and English, needs no account and never tracks you.

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.a1: Yes. There are no fees, no ads and no paywall. Everything here, including the planner, maps and games, is free to use.
faq.a2: No. There are no ad networks or tracking scripts, and the fonts and images are hosted by us. We only count visits per day, with no personal details. The districts you tick stay in your own browser unless you choose to make an account.
faq.a3: All 64 districts, 257 places (130 well known and 127 lesser known), 150 route pages and 120 intercity train timetables.
faq.q4: How current are the fares and train times?
faq.a4: Each fare and timetable shows the date it was checked and how confident we are, with links to the sources. Fares change often, so confirm at the counter or on the official e-ticket site before you travel.
faq.a5: No. You can explore, plan trips, tick districts and send photos without one. An account only adds saved trips, your profile and syncing between devices.
faq.q6: Can I add my own photos, places or business?
faq.a6: Yes. Send a photo, suggest a place or a food from your area, or list your business. A person reads every submission before it appears on the site.

footer.credit: Made for travellers in Bangladesh. Free, with no trackers.

safety.title: Safety and packing
safety.metaTitle: Bangladesh travel safety: emergency numbers and packing lists
safety.metaDescription: Tap-to-call emergency numbers for Bangladesh, a share-my-location helper, travel safety tips and five packing checklists.
safety.intro: Numbers to call, a way to tell someone where you are, and what to bring. Save this page offline before you go to places with a weak signal.
safety.n999: National emergency service: police, fire service, ambulance
safety.n16263: Shastho Batayon: medical advice by phone
safety.n109: Helpline against violence towards women and children
safety.locIntro: Make a map link with your position and send it to family or a friend. Your position stays in your browser: it is not sent to our servers.
safety.locDenied: Location is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
safety.locUnavailable: Could not find your position. Move to an open area and try again.
safety.locUnsupported: This browser cannot find your position.
safety.tipHills: Hill Tracts (Bandarban, Rangamati, Khagrachhari): some areas need a permit from the district administration, and some roads close after dark. Check before you go.
safety.tipSea: Watch the signal flags at beaches and ferry terminals. Do not swim or board a boat when a danger signal is up.
safety.tipTrails: Trails in the hills and the Sundarbans are slippery after rain. Wear shoes with grip and go with a local guide.
safety.tipId: Carry your ID or a copy of your passport. Checkpoints on highways and in the hills may ask for it.
safety.tipPhoto: Ask before you photograph people, and never photograph military or border areas.
safety.tipLife: Wear a life jacket on every boat, even if nobody else does.
safety.tipRubbish: Carry your rubbish back with you. Many places have no bins.
safety.packIntro: Start with Always, then add the lists that fit your trip. Tick items as you pack.
safety.pack_always_1: ID or a copy of your passport
safety.pack_always_2: Phone charger and a power bank
safety.pack_monsoon_4: Sandals or shoes with good grip
safety.pack_monsoon_6: Plastic pouch for phone and papers
safety.pack_winter_1: Light jacket or shawl for mornings
safety.pack_winter_2: Warm layer for the hills and for fog
safety.pack_winter_3: Scarf for river and train journeys
safety.pack_hills_4: Offline map and the trail downloaded
safety.pack_hills_6: Permit and ID copies for the Hill Tracts
safety.pack_sea_5: Water shoes or sandals that stay on

about.title: About Unseen BD
about.metaDescription: What Unseen BD is, how its facts are checked, who made the photos and maps, and how your data is handled.
about.intro: A free travel guide, map and trip planner for all 64 districts of Bangladesh.
about.whatBody1: Unseen BD helps you find places worth the trip, from famous beaches to villages few people visit. Every district has a page, every place has a guide, and the planner turns your list into a route with costs.
about.whatBody2: You can keep a map of the districts you have visited, play quizzes, share cards, and add photos and stories. It is free to use and has no ads or trackers.
about.verifyBody1: Routes, fares and train timetables show a confidence label (high, medium or low) and where the figure came from. Place and district texts are written for Unseen BD.
about.verifyBody2: Photos, posts, listings and suggestions from visitors are checked by a moderator before anyone else can see them. Prices and timetables change, so confirm with the operator before you travel.
about.creditPhotos: Photos: Wikimedia Commons photographers. Each photo shows its author and licence and links to its Commons page.
about.creditFonts: Fonts: DM Serif Display and Hind Siliguri, served from this site under the SIL Open Font Licence.
about.creditArt: Illustrations, icons and place covers: made for Unseen BD.
about.privacyIntro: What this site stores about you, in full. There are no ad networks, analytics or trackers, and fonts and images are served from this site.
about.pvBrowser: On your device: the districts and countries you mark, your bucket list, trip draft, game records, card settings and your theme choice are kept in your browser (local storage and a theme cookie). Clearing site data removes them.
about.pvVisits: Visits are counted as daily totals only. We do not keep a record per visitor.
about.pvDevice: Likes, votes and reports without an account use a random device cookie (ubd_device, one year) so one device counts once. Your IP address is kept only as a one-way hash, for quotas and abuse checks.
about.pvAccount: With an account: we keep your email, display name and a hashed password, and your visited districts, trips and wish list so they follow you across devices. Sign-in uses cookies (ubd_session, ubd_signed_in, ubd_csrf). Signing in with Google loads Google Identity, and only then.
about.pvUploads: Uploads: photos are shrunk and re-encoded in your browser, so location data (EXIF and GPS) never leaves your device, and the server strips metadata again. Nothing you send is public until a moderator approves it. An email address on a photo form is for the moderators and is never shown.
about.pvLocation: Share my location (Safety page) and Near me read your position in your browser only. It is not sent to us.
about.pvOffline: Keep offline stores pages and pictures on your device. You can remove them from the same button.
about.pvDelete: To have your account, photos or posts removed, delete them from your profile or write to us through Suggest a correction.
about.tm1: The guide is for planning and comes without a warranty. Opening hours, prices, timetables and road conditions change, so confirm before you travel and follow local rules and advice.
about.tm2: Send only photos you took yourself and stories you wrote. By sending them you let Unseen BD show them on the site, with your display name, after approval. You keep the rights to your work and can delete it at any time.
about.tm3: Be respectful. Posts that are abusive, misleading, advertise without being marked, or show people without their consent are removed.
about.tm4: Business listings are submitted by their owners and checked by a moderator. Paid placements are always marked Sponsored.
about.tm5: Photos from Wikimedia Commons stay under their authors' licences, shown under each photo.
about.tm6: We can change or remove content and these terms at any time.
